messages:
marta: Need to spin up an A/B experiment in Console today for the compose endpoint. Goal: compare model-v2-quant against current control (model-v1.4) for latency, cost-per-token, and regenerate rate. Want a safe canary + auto-ramp and clear guards. Any objections?

anish: sounds good. propose initial split 95/5 (control/variant) with an automated ramp to 25/25/50/100 over 24h if health checks pass. also add a per-tenant qps cap for the variant.

leo: agree on 95/5 start. we should restrict the experiment to non-enterprise tenants and only the /compose route so we don't affect high-cost flows. small note: quantized model changes quality distribution --- include regen_rate and answer-divergence as metrics.

marta: yep restrict by route + customer_tier. also need an emergency kill-switch if error rate or latency spikes. what's the recommended guard thresholds?

anish: propose guards: max_error_rate = baseline * 1.5 (absolute floor 0.02), max_median_latency_ms = baseline + 250ms, and immediate stop if cost_per_token increases > 35% vs control. Also throttle variant to 10 qps per tenant initially.

leo: +1. And require at least 200 requests per variant before we consider ramping to the next step to avoid noisy stats.

samy: on telemetry: ensure experiment_id and variant_id are tagged on all traces and logs. also expose per-variant token_count and token_cost metrics to Console so product can chart cost-per-request. We'll need to add those tags to the router headers: X-Rwd-Experiment and X-Rwd-Variant.

marta: can we show example config for Console so PM/design can review?

anish: here's a draft config we can paste into Console's experiment JSON editor:

```json
{
  "experiment_name": "compose-quant-abtest-2024-06",
  "target_routes": ["/compose"],
  "target_tiers": ["free","pro","startup"],
  "variants": [
    {"id":"control","model":"rwd/model-v1.4","weight":95},
    {"id":"v2q","model":"rwd/model-v2-quant","weight":5}
  ],
  "ramp_policy": {
    "type":"time_based",
    "steps": [
      {"after":"1h","weights":{"control":95,"v2q":5}},
      {"after":"6h","weights":{"control":75,"v2q":25}},
      {"after":"12h","weights":{"control":50,"v2q":50}},
      {"after":"24h","weights":{"control":0,"v2q":100}}
    ],
    "min_samples_per_variant": 200
  },
  "guards": {
    "max_error_rate_multiplier": 1.5,
    "abs_error_rate_floor": 0.02,
    "max_median_latency_increase_ms": 250,
    "max_cost_increase_pct": 35,
    "qps_per_tenant_variant": 10
  },
  "metrics": ["latency_ms","error_rate","token_cost","regen_pct","answer_divergence"],
  "telemetry_headers": {"experiment_header":"X-Rwd-Experiment","variant_header":"X-Rwd-Variant"},
  "auto_kill": true
}
```

leo: that looks solid. small UX ask: Console should surface the ramp schedule in the experiment summary and let SRE pause or step-back (decrease percentage) manually. also expose a quick "kill" button that overrides scheduling.

marta: agree. product design needs mockups for the experiment page: (1) summary, (2) live traffic split chart, (3) per-variant metric sparklines, (4) quick controls (pause/kill/step-back).

anish: implementation note: router must evaluate target_rules before global routing so we don't accidentally send enterprise traffic. suggest rule order: tenant_tier filter -> route path filter -> sampling rng for traffic split -> qps gate -> forward.

samy: also add a safety net: if variant's aggregate latency exceeds threshold for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows, auto-rollback to control with an incident log in Console and a notification to #incidents.

leo: regarding telemetry retention: for experiments we should keep per-variant raw samples for 7 days by default and aggregated metrics for 30 days. that helps post-mortem.

marta: can someone make the Console UX change ticket? I'll include the PM spec and the draft config.

anish: I'll file the infra/console ticket and add the JSON in the PR. pinging @samy for telemetry work.

samy: I'll add the headers and metrics hooks, and a small change to the router to enforce qps_per_tenant_variant. will post a PR today.

deploy-bot: experiment compose-quant-abtest-2024-06 created by anish in Console (id: exp_01F8aX). link: https://console.redwood.ai/experiments/exp_01F8aX :rocket:

marta: awesome. once PRs land let's do a staged rollout next week. I'll coordinate with analytics to make dashboards for regen_rate and divergence. :thumbsup:

leo: one last thought — add an opt-out header for internal test clients (X-Rwd-Bypass-Experiment) so devtools & QA can avoid getting variant traffic.

anish: good call, adding that to the config.

marta: thanks all. I'll close this thread once dashboards + infra PRs are green.
